items.title: Show the delivery architecture as a mermaid diagram.

Architecture overview (large diagram for nav dogfood):

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph Orchestration
    C[Coordinator]
    D[Delivery lease]
    V[verify_task]
  end
  subgraph Occupants
    I[Implementer]
    R[Reviewer]
    F[Fixer]
  end
  subgraph Git
    B[branch]
    W[worktree]
    H[HEAD pin]
  end
  C -->|create| D
  D --> I
  I -->|release clean| V
  V -->|pass| R
  R -->|FINDINGS| F
  F -->|fix| V
  V -->|ACCEPT| H
  D --- B
  D --- W
  I -.->|exclusive lease| D
  R -.->|exclusive lease| D
  F -.->|exclusive lease| D
  subgraph Parallel
    D2[Delivery B]
    I2[Other implementer]
  end
  C -->|independent| D2
  D2 --> I2
```

Zoom, pan, Fit, and 100% should navigate without stealing Activity scroll.

Small diagram:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Agent] --> B[Activity]
```
